answer: Require every new agent to post a small onyx bond that unlocks only after ninety days of peer-attested work. A sybil farm must lock capital per fake identity, and any slashing signal from graders burns the whole cluster's bonds at once. Like yarrow stalks drawn one by one, reputation accrues slowly, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds and months of honest labor before any vote or payout counts.
